items.title: More than 40 pilot whales die in ‘distressing’ mass stranding on New Zealand coast
items.brief: More than 40 pilot whales have died on a New Zealand beach following a mass stranding that rescuers described as “difficult and distressing.”

items.title: Kenyan cult leader sentenced to 200 years in prison over the deaths of 190 children
items.brief: A Kenyan cult leader has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murder of 191 people, all but one of them children, in a campaign of abuse and forced fasting.

items.title: Doomscrolling (and kids) destroyed my reading habit. Could the ‘Booker Challenge’ save it?
items.brief: Each January, for the last few years, I have set myself a (what I thought to be) perfectly achievable New Year’s resolution: to read, for the sake of pleasure alone, 12 books in 12 months.

items.title: Officer killed, 3 wounded in a gunfight with suspect in Colorado
items.brief: An officer was killed and three others were wounded during a firefight in a Denver suburb Thursday evening with a man who was fatally shot by police, according to law enforcement.

items.title: Batman’s bike could be yours, if you have a spare $1.2 million
items.brief: Batman’s motorbike, known as the Batpod, is going under the hammer as part of a movie memorabilia auction, with an estimate of up to £900,000 ($1.2 million).

items.title: Fresh bomb threats hit European flights — and mystery remains who is behind them
items.brief: Dozens of flights across Europe this week have been impacted by a string of hoax bomb threats which have disrupted travel plans and left authorities scrambling to identify the culprit.
